source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: To find how a product changes after its factors are adjusted, expand the new product and separate the original product from the remaining change terms.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Adjustments m and n is the label that belongs on this item, so 'To find how a product changes after its factors are adjusted, expand' is answered as adjustments m and n rather than original product ab.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Adjustments m and n is what produces original product ab, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about To find how a product changes after its factors are.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: original product ab is settled by running 'Choose a decomposition or special identity that turns a numerical': A number may be rewritten as a convenient sum or difference and then multiplied using — on the item about To find how a product changes after its factors are.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Original product ab is found by dividing the given values instead of multiplying, giving 89 as the reported result — on the item about To find how a product changes after its factors are.

intelligence.enrichment: If ab becomes (a + m)(b + n), then the new product is ab + an + bm + mn, so the change from ab is an + bm + mn.
